pattern.heic and pattern.png are synthetic test images created for this repository.
No external photograph or personal image was used. They and generate-pattern.py
are provided under the repository's MIT License.

The image is 64 by 48 pixels. Its four solid-color quadrants are RGB (240, 20, 30),
(20, 220, 40), (30, 40, 230), and (240, 240, 240).

Generation:
  python3 tests/fixtures/generate-pattern.py
  sips -s format heic tests/fixtures/pattern.png --out tests/fixtures/pattern.heic

sips is only used to produce the checked-in fixture. The plugin and automated
tests do not use sips, a native HEIC decoder, or an external conversion service.
The browser test converts this HEIC fixture with the bundled heic-to decoder.
